# healthcare-core

Foundation for all healthcare work: version resolution, interoperability architecture, security/privacy review, terminology and conformance testing.

Install: `copilot plugin install healthcare-core@healthcare-copilot` (see the repository README).

## Agents
- `healthcare-interop-architect`
- `healthcare-security-privacy-reviewer`
- `clinical-terminology-specialist`
- `healthcare-conformance-tester`

## Skills
- `healthcare-version-detect`
- `phi-deidentification`
- `conformance-test-plan`
- `terminology-binding`

## Hooks (install manually)
- `phi-scanner`: copy `hooks/phi-scanner/` from the repository to `.github/hooks/phi-scanner/`
